info.title: Matomo Reporting API for CrashAnalytics plugin

get.description: Merges multiple crashes so they will be treated as the same crash in reports.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the website to update.

parameters.name: idLogCrashes
parameters.description: Crash IDs to merge. Accepts a single ID, an array of IDs, or a comma-separated list.

get.description: Unmerge a previously merged crash group.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the website to update.

parameters.name: idLogCrash
parameters.description: The crash group ID to unmerge.

get.description: Gets every merged crash group for a site.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the website to query.

200.description:
Merged crash groups keyed by the parent crash ID.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Gets the list of unique crash types that were tracked for a specific site.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the website to query.

parameters.name: filter_limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of crash types to return, or false to return all results.

200.description:
Unique crash types tracked for the site.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Set whether a crash should be ignored when tracking or whether it should no longer be ignored.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the website to update.

parameters.name: idLogCrash
parameters.description: The crash ID to update.

parameters.name: ignore
parameters.description: Whether to ignore the crash. Truthy values ignore the crash for future tracking, falsy values unignore it.

get.description: Get the list of currently ignored crashes for a site.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the website to query.

200.description:
Ignored crashes with their crash details and source metadata.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Gets information for a specific crash including it's message, originating source and other information, if one can be found. The most recently tracked crash and page URL that encountered the crash will also be included.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the website to query.

parameters.name: idLogCrash
parameters.description: The crash ID to summarize.

200.description:
Crash summary details, including the latest crash event information when available.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Gets the crash visit context, which includes information about the most recent visits that encountered the crash and the actions that occurred just before the crash.

parameters.name: idLogCrash
parameters.description: The crash ID to inspect.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the website to query.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The period to process, processes data for the period containing the specified date.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The date or date range to process. 'YYYY-MM-DD', magic keywords (today, yesterday, lastWeek, lastMonth, lastYear), or date range (ie, 'YYYY-MM-DD,YYYY-MM-DD', lastX, previousX).

parameters.name: segment
parameters.description: Custom segment to filter the report. Example: "referrerName==example.com" Supports AND (;) and OR (,) operators.

parameters.name: filter_limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of crash events to return.

parameters.name: filter_offset
parameters.description: Offset for paging through the crash events.

parameters.name: fetchRecentActions
parameters.description: Whether to include the actions that occurred before each crash event.

200.description:
Recent crash events with visit context and optional preceding actions.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Gets the list of every crash tracked for a site.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the website to query.

parameters.name: filter_sort_column
parameters.description: The crash field to sort by.

parameters.name: filter_sort_order
parameters.description: Sort direction, either "asc" or "desc".

parameters.name: filter_limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of crashes to return. Values above 10000 are capped.

parameters.name: filter_offset
parameters.description: Offset for paging through the result set.

200.description:
All tracked crashes for the site after sorting and paging are applied.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Gets an overview report for crashes encountered. Includes overall metrics like the total number of crashes encountered, how many were new, how many disappeared within the period, etc.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: Website ID(s) to query. - Single site ID (e.g. 1) - Multiple site IDs (e.g. [1, 4, 5]) - Comma-separated list ("1,4,5") or "all"

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The period to process, processes data for the period containing the specified date.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The date or date range to process. 'YYYY-MM-DD', magic keywords (today, yesterday, lastWeek, lastMonth, lastYear), or date range (ie, 'YYYY-MM-DD,YYYY-MM-DD', lastX, previousX).

parameters.name: segment
parameters.description: Custom segment to filter the report. Example: "referrerName==example.com" Supports AND (;) and OR (,) operators.

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: Metrics to include, as an array or comma-separated list.

200.description:
Overview metrics for crashes encountered during the requested period.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

GenericSuccessXml.description: Generic Matomo success payload in XML.

ErrorXml.description: Generic Matomo error payload in XML.

text\/plain.example: Error: You must be logged in to access this functionality.

text\/html.example: You must be logged in to access this functionality.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but not allowed to access the resource.

text\/plain.example: Error: The method is not available.

GenericString.description: Generic 200 response with only a string body

GenericBoolean.description: Generic 200 response with only true or false as the body

GenericInteger.description: Generic 200 response with only an integer as the body

formatRequired.name: format
formatRequired.description: Response format such as `xml` or `json`. Use `original` to get the original PHP data structure.

formatOptional.name: format
formatOptional.description: Response format. Defaults to `xml`. Use `original` to get the original PHP data structure.

flatOptional.name: flat
flatOptional.description: Flatten subtables into the parent table.

filter_columnOptional.name: filter_column
filter_columnOptional.description: Column to apply the regex to (e.g., `label`).

filter_column_recursiveOptional.name: filter_column_recursive
filter_column_recursiveOptional.description: Column for the recursive regex filter.

filter_excludelowpopOptional.name: filter_excludelowpop
filter_excludelowpopOptional.description: Column to threshold and exclude low values.

filter_truncateOptional.name: filter_truncate
filter_truncateOptional.description: Row index after which rows are removed.

filter_limitOptional.name: filter_limit
filter_limitOptional.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

hideColumnsOptional.name: hideColumns
hideColumnsOptional.description: Comma-separated list of columns to hide.

showColumnsOptional.name: showColumns
showColumnsOptional.description: Comma-separated list of columns to include.

labelOptional.name: label
labelOptional.description: Keep only rows with these label(s). Supports path via '>' and arrays.

idGoalRequired.name: idGoal
idGoalRequired.description: The ID of a configured goal.

idGoalOptional.name: idGoal
idGoalOptional.description: The ID of a configured goal.

MatomoToken.description: Paste your token generated from Personal > Security. Swagger will send it as a Bearer token.

tags.name: CrashAnalytics
tags.description: Exposes Crash Analytics endpoints for managing tracked crashes and querying crash reports. Includes summary, drill-down, historical, and realtime reporting APIs for a single site.
